mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey where personal conviction meets public duty inside one of the most intense environments imaginable—the Trump White House. Imagine, every day, standing under the brightest spotlight in the nation, where faith, freedom, and fierce debate are just part of the job description. We're about to step into the world that Sarah Huckabee Sanders shares in her book, Speaking for Myself: Faith, Freedom, and the Fight of Our Lives Inside the Trump White House. In this story, the lines between what you believe and what you must do aren’t always clear, and the stakes are as high as they come. Together, we’ll explore how moments of vulnerability and strength often go hand in hand, and how faith can become both your anchor and your guide when the going gets tough. We’ll get a first-hand look at loyalty, truth, and leadership, navigating the pressures that shape decisions—both at the podium and behind closed doors. So, if you’ve ever wondered what it takes to maintain integrity—and a sense of purpose—when the world is watching your every move, you’re in the right place. Let’s dive in and discover what it really means to speak for yourself when every word matters.
